btc-low-vol-cash-v1.rationale: Unhedged BTC long exposure is only held when 20-day realized volatility is below a frozen threshold; otherwise cash.
btc-low-vol-cash-v1.failure: Reject if validation return is not positive after costs, does not beat cash, or has fewer than 12 trades.

spy-sma200-cash-v1.rationale: SPY is held only while its completed close is above the 200-day average; otherwise cash. This is a trend filter, not relative-strength rotation.
spy-sma200-cash-v1.failure: Reject if validation underperforms SPY buy-and-hold after costs or has fewer than 8 trades.
